messages:
Sara Sales: Hey team — onboarding convo with NorthGrid. They want a multi-year commitment but need a split billing + partial upfront. Can we do 30% upfront, then quarterly invoices, and net45 on the rest?
Omar Deals: Do we have precedent for mix of upfront + net45 across years?
Jess AR: We usually do either full annual upfront or net30/45 for entire term. Mixing is OK but needs special approval and SOW clarity. Also need PO and billing contact.
Priya PM: POC still in flight — security questionnaire still open (SOC2 section). Legal flagged a few items about data residency that might affect the contract timelines.
Sara Sales: They asked for escrow of remaining annual payments in case of acquisition. That's new. Pricing asked for 20% discount on list for 3yr commit.
Dan Legal: Escrow requests are high friction. We need exact trigger language and escrow agent. If they insist, scope an escrow addendum. Will need 2-3 business days.
Omar Deals: Pricing: 20% on list for 3yr with 30% upfront seems aggressive. What commit tier are they hitting?
Sara Sales: They want reserved capacity (dedicated), estimated 4x baseline. ARR would put them in the enterprise band but not top tier.
Jess AR: Finance input: we can accept 30% upfront + quarterly invoices for the balance with net45, but only if invoice schedule and late fee terms are explicit and credit team signs off. Also need a credit-check holdback option.
Finance Bot: Payment terms template: Upfront Amount = 30% of Year1 Total. Remaining invoiced quarterly in arrears. Net terms: 45 days. Late fee: 1.5%/month after due date. Subject to credit approval.
Priya PM: Security: if SOC2 control gaps remain, we should add a 60-day remediation clause and limit sensitive data processing until remediated. That will need legal signoff.
Dan Legal: TL;DR: I can draft the escrow addendum + remediation clause. Need to know final pricing and whether we accept the 20% discount.
Omar Deals: Approve a conditional 15% discount for 3yr if they commit to 4x capacity and 30% upfront + escrow language acceptable. Finance to confirm credit terms. Legal to prepare addenda.
Jess AR: Noted. I'll run the credit check and confirm AR playbook. If credit holds, I can approve net45 on remaining invoices with the stated late fee.
Sara Sales: I'll push this to the customer and ask for exact escrow agent and billing contact. Also request their PO template.
Omar Deals: Thanks. If we get credit OK and security remediation window accepted, we can route to Deal Desk for sign-off. @Dan Legal @Jess AR please leave any hard stops here.
Dan Legal: Hard stop: no escrow-trigger that circumvents our refund/termination rights. Also require narrow scope for escrow release events.
Jess AR: Hard stop: must have billing contact and PO before first invoice. Otherwise switch to prepay for Year2.
Sara Sales: Got it. Will update thread with names + PO tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Finance Bot: Deal Desk checklist added: pricing tier, discount %, upfront invoice amount, escrow agent, credit result, security remediation window.
Omar Deals: Great. If everything checks, finalize terms and I will approve the exception.
Sara Sales: Closing this for now — will post update after PO + escrow agent.
